candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Ego follows a slightly shifted route with a slower cross-traffic vehicle introduced near a red or changing light, encouraging a side-impact collision while ego keeps moving without clear braking.
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Reposition the linear-moving vehicle to act as cross-traffic near a controlled intersection and slightly adjust ego mission, so a collision occurs under active non-green signals with intact perception/prediction/waypoints and no clear braking, while keeping the underlying responsibility ambiguous across modules.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Verify that the adjusted mission route still encounters at least one intersection controlled by traffic lights with proper signal scheduling.
Ensure actor_index 1 (linear vehicle) trajectory intersects or closely passes the ego route near a signalized junction within the run duration.
Confirm that ego and actor_index 1 are configured so they reach the intersection with overlapping time windows likely to create a collision opportunity.
Check that perception-related topics are enabled and not suppressed by the slight improvement in visibility (reduced fog).
post_execution_validation_rules: Require oracle to report a collision involving the ego; additionally, accept cases where a red_light violation is also reported, treating them as compound outcomes.
Confirm via logs that at least one traffic light affecting or near the ego path shows a red or transitioning state shortly before collision.
Check that ego maintains nonzero forward speed in the final seconds before collision; exclude runs where ego is fully stationary well before impact.
Verify presence of detection objects and prediction tracks for nearby actors (especially actor_index 1) in the pre-collision window, and continuous final_waypoints up to collision.
Inspect vehicle_cmd and vehicle_status to ensure there is no strong, sustained braking sufficiently ahead of impact to count as a successful avoidance maneuver.
Do not enforce lane_invasion as necessary; treat any reported lane_invasion as incidental and not defining for same-root-cause.
If the oracle only reports collision without red_light, still accept as same-root-cause as long as non-green traffic light states existed in the vicinity and time window of the collision.
uncertainty: Whether the oracle will flag a red_light violation in addition to collision depends on the exact stop-line geometry and signal phase at crossing time.

The precise allocation of fault between perception (e.g., missed objects), planning (e.g., unadjusted waypoints), and actuation (e.g., ineffective braking) cannot be determined from scenario-level specification.
Lane-invasion behavior may or may not be present and is not constrained by this variant.
